'''Joseph Zyss''' (born in 1950) is a [[French people|French]] [[physicist]] who specialises in molecular [[photonics]] and [[nonlinear optics]]. He is the author or co-author of more than 600 articles in the field.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Joseph_Zyss|title= Joseph Zyss|website= researchgate.net}}</ref>

==Career==
From 1975 to 1997, Zyss worked at the [[Centre national d'études des télécommunications|CNET]]'s Bagneux Laboratory. Subsequently he has worked in the Laboratoire de photonique quantique et moléculaire (UMR 8537), and is its former director (1998–2006). In 2002, he was the founder of the {{ill|Jean-Le-Rond-d'Alembert Institute|fr|Institut Jean-Le-Rond-d'Alembert}} (IFR 121), and served as its director until 2015. He also founded the European Associated Laboratory (LEA NaBi), a collaboration between [[CNRS]] and the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]] in the field of [[Nanobiotechnology|nanobiotechnologies]]. As of 2018, he is an Emeritus professor at the [[École normale supérieure de Cachan]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ens-cachan.fr/lecole/distinctions/joseph-zyss|title=Joseph Zyss - ENS-PARIS-SACLAY|website=www.ens-cachan.fr|access-date=2018-02-25|archive-date=2018-02-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180226032431/https://www.ens-cachan.fr/lecole/distinctions/joseph-zyss|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Research==
His research has focused on molecular [[photonics]]. He specialises in molecular-level [[nonlinear optics|nonlinear optical effects]].<ref>{{Citation | last=Zyss| first=Joseph | year=1994 | title=Molecular Nonlinear Optics : Materials, Physics and Devices| publisher=[[Academic Press]] | isbn=0-521-63303-6}}</ref> These researches have linked basic [[physical chemistry]] with technologies and applications including polymers for [[information technology]] and [[biophotonics]] imaging.<ref>{{Citation | last=Kuhn | first=Hans Jochen | year=1991 | title=Nonlinear Optical Materials =CRC Press | publisher=CRC Press | isbn=9780849301476}}</ref>

==Awards and honours==
Zyss is an elected fellow of [[The Optical Society]],<ref>[http://www.prixjeanjerphagnon.org/files/prix-jean-jerphagnon/jury/joseph-zyss.pdf Joseph Zyss] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180226032252/http://www.prixjeanjerphagnon.org/files/prix-jean-jerphagnon/jury/joseph-zyss.pdf |date=2018-02-26 }}</ref> and has been awarded the [[Société Française de Physique]]'s IBM prize and {{ill|Yves-Rocard Award|fr|Prix Yves-Rocard}}, as well as the [[Gay-Lussac-Humboldt-Prize]] (2010).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sfp.in2p3.fr/Prix/prix.html#rocard|title=Prix de la SFP|website=sfp.in2p3.fr}}</ref>
